hosted_acl_root_cause.root_cause: The table was created under a public-schema default ACL that grants authenticated broad table privileges. The migration explicitly revoked anon but did not revoke authenticated, so the inherited authenticated privileges remained while SELECT was additionally granted.

deployment_checkpoint.commit_message: docs: checkpoint 2026-09-20 mobile and customer account decisions

required_next_evidence: Independently review and bind the recovered Hosted statement fingerprint to an approved change record; the continuity checkpoint proves that the named migration was reported as applied, but it is not the original SQL artifact or an independent approval.
Record reviewer identity, review timestamp, resolution method and evidence reference without publishing customer-specific values or the raw ledger created_by value.
Keep the historical migration quarantined from replay; use the separately disposable-proven least-privilege remediation for future controlled staging after the linked dry-run gate is satisfied.
Prove a trusted idempotent customer-number allocator and cross-tenant negative behavior in controlled non-Production staging before any Hosted promotion.
